subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Theme 4 - Unit 3: The Best and the Worst
outcomes: Read an essay about the most helpful and harmful inventions
Use word forms like invent, invention and inventor
Give an argument with reasons about an invention

tf.s: The writer lists the wheel as a helpful invention.
tf.why: Yes! The wheel is needed for most types of transportation.

tf.s: The writer lists money as a harmful invention.
tf.why: Money is on the writer's helpful list; it helps businesses develop.

tf.s: The writer says cars are harmful because they cause global warming and traffic deaths.
tf.why: Right! The essay gives both reasons.

tf.s: Cigarettes are one of the harmful inventions in the essay.
tf.why: Correct! The essay says smoking causes millions of deaths a year.
Yes! The ending -y makes the noun here.

tf.s: Paper is helpful because it allows us to keep and share information.
tf.why: Right! Modern technology depends on it too.

tf.s: A good argument gives reasons and an example.
tf.why: Yes! Reasons make an argument strong.
